title: Ship regenerates a capability-index-only conflict instead of exiting 76
body:
Why: on 2026-11-14 the t-pj744qg lane's bin/krn pr ship exited 76 on a conflict only in docs/generated/capability-index.md, after f1618a9 (t-vnm73ha) made ship regenerate generated-only rebase conflicts; the lane resolved it by hand with origin/main's copy and --force.
Outcome: a rebase whose only conflicts are generated files (capability-index included) is regenerated by ship and does not exit 76; if the lane's pinned entry predates f1618a9 the cause is named.
Proof: a ship test reproducing a capability-index-only conflict against the real rebase path exits 0; npm run fast PASS.
